hooks.command: d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/loci"; [ -f "$d/docs/CHECKPOINT.md" ] || exit 0; git -C "$d" diff --quiet -- docs/CHECKPOINT.md src/loci/tickets.py 2>/dev/null && exit 0; cd "$d" && uv run --quiet loci check-tickets --hook
hooks.statusMessage: loci: checking every decision has a Linear ticket

hooks.command: d="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/loci"; [ -f "$d/docs/CHECKPOINT.md" ] || exit 0; cd "$d" && uv run --quiet loci check-tickets >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'loci check-tickets failed: every CHECKPOINT decision needs a Linear ticket (or a tickets.RULINGS entry) before committing. Run: cd loci && uv run loci check-tickets' >&2; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: loci: ticket coverage gate before commit
